title: Western Star Custom FUPS Bullbar for 4800 4900 series #4
description: Western Star heavy duty Aero style FUPS Bullbar for 4800 / 4900 series trucks. Rhinoceros bar with heavy gauge aluminium mesh that saves headlight and animal damage. Built with 76mm diameter pipe but 88mm & 100mm also available. Two centre pipes allow tow pin access. Custom driving light mounts to customer specifications. Optional Dimension & Road Train signs on main bar.
